question: Flight Lieutenant ______ had created history in May 2019 by becoming the first woman to qualify for combat missions on a fighter jet.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhawana Kanth.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhawana Kanth created history in** May 2019 **by becoming the **first woman to qualify for combat missions** on a fighter jet in the** Indian Air Force.**
 
• Her qualification opened up **opportunities for women to serve in combat roles **in the Indian armed forces.
 
• Bhawana Kanth received her initial training at the** Air Force Academy in Dundigal, Telangana, **and showcased exceptional skills and dedication during her training.
 
• Her accomplishment as a fighter pilot serves as a **source of inspiration for women** across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Priya Jhingan:**

 
 
• Priya Jhingan is an **Indian lawyer** and** a former officer in the Indian Army.**
 
• She is notable for being one of the** first women to join the Indian Army as a Short Service Commission officer.**
 
• Priya Jhingan and another woman,** Lt. G. R. Khanna**, filed a landmark case in the** Delhi High Court in 1992 challenging the denial of permanent commission to women officers in the Indian Army.**
 
 
 
• **Harita Kaur Deol:**
 
 
• Harita Kaur Deol is an** Indian Air Force officer** who made headlines in** 1994 for her pioneering achievements.**
 
• She became the** first woman to fly solo in a fighter aircraft** when she flew a **MiG-21 Bison.**
 
• Unfortunately, she tragically** lost her life in an air crash soon after, in 1996**, during a routine training mission.
 
• Harita Kaur Deol's bravery and accomplishments continue to inspire generations of women aspiring to join the Indian Air Force.
 
 
 
• **Shanti Tigga:**
 
 
• Shanti Tigga made history in **2012 by becoming the first woman jawan (soldier) **in the Indian Army.
 
• She joined the Corps of Signals in the Indian Army and served as** a riflewoman.**
 
• While Shanti Tigga's achievement is significant in **breaking gender barriers **in the Indian Army.
 
• Nonetheless, her determination and trailblazing role have contributed to women's empowerment and inclusion in the Indian armed forces.
